pattern: asked to set up styal actions; config written without reading the project-setup guide
experience: Agents asked to configure project actions only knew T3 Code's t3.json, so they wrote the old format or guessed at styal.json fields. Fork #279 tried to fix this with a per-session skill.
prompt: Set up styal actions for this repo: new worktrees should install dependencies and get a copy of my .env, and I want the dev server and tests in the actions menu.

pattern: ordinary code fix; no guide read
experience: A guide read on ordinary coding work wastes a call and context.
prompt: The formatDate test fails. Fix it.

pattern: repo has only a t3.json; asked for an action; agent adds it to t3.json
experience: t3.json scripts do not run until they are imported or migrated, so an action an agent adds to t3.json never appears in the actions menu. The agent should offer to migrate to styal.json.
prompt: Add a lint action to this project so I can run it from the actions menu.
